name: @lacspace/extractive
description: Turn a full article into a compact brief for an AI writer — extractive TextRank summary, key-facts (numbers, money, percentages, dates, named entities), headline candidates and key phrases/hashtags, for English and Nepali (sentence splitting on the danda '।', decimal-safe). Deterministic, no LLM; reuses @lacspace/keyphrase and @lacspace/factcheck-lite. Exposes a describe() command schema so an AI 'conductor' can drive it.
author: Lacspace <contact@lacspace.com>
